summary: Cut the mailbox stream API (api::mailbox: the per-seat delivery socket, bind, receipts and attachment routes, native peer authority and the mailbox profile) out of st3-api into the new st3-api-mailbox crate. st3-api's router now takes the route families of the crates above it; the mailbox routes are one, added before the same envelope and leave layers, so every route, path and response is unchanged and every module keeps its old path.
